title: Operator CLI: no tracebacks on expected failures, consistent exit codes, shell wins over .env
description:
src/papyrus/cli.py:60-62 raises IndexError when --backend is the last token. src/papyrus/operator/runtime.py:79-82 suppresses tracebacks only for OperatorError and ValueError, so an expired SSO session (RuntimeError from src/papyrus_content/graphql_http.py:70, 'GraphQL request failed: 401') prints a full traceback, which AGENTS.md says must print recovery guidance instead. src/papyrus_newsroom/cli.py has no except at all, so run-story-cycle tracebacks on every failure. Exit codes are 1 (papyrus_content/cli.py:396), 2 (runtime.py:52) or 2-only-if-the-message-contains-'unknown backend' (papyrus/cli.py:349). src/papyrus_content/env.py:25-27 makes .env override an already-exported PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT. Three thin _graphql wrappers set three different timeouts (coverage_theme.py:6398 90s, reference_curation_signals.py:4294 60s, newsroom.py:4022 30s) while PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS already exists in env.py:71.

Fix: one OperatorError type with an explicit exit_code raised everywhere; treat RuntimeError from the GraphQL layer as operator-facing (print the status and 'run aws sso login for profile X'); shell-wins precedence for env; delete the three wrappers. Add behave scenarios to features/operator-cli.feature for expired credentials and the dangling --backend.

Done when: no expected failure prints a Python traceback and every entry point exits 2 on operator error.

Source: full code review of develop @ e9b1923 on 2026-10-17 (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/f01a3c9f-7fad-4df2-8a15-ac6c27cc83ed). Branch from origin/develop, name the branch after this issue, open a PR into develop, and record branch, PR link and verification in a comment here before closing.
